_comment_disabled: Set to false to enable this datapack and override the default mod config.
_comment_formula: Final attribute value = Original Attribute Value + Base Value * (1 + multiply * difficulty)
_comment_weightBase: Base value added to weight at difficulty 0. [Min: 0]
_comment_weightMultiply: How much the added weight increases per difficulty. For example, a value of 0.05 means the added weight increases by 5% per difficulty. [Min: 0, Max: 1]
_comment_impactBase: Base value added to impact at difficulty 0. [Min: 0]
_comment_impactMultiply: How much the added impact increases per difficulty. For example, a value of 0.05 means the added impact increases by 5% per difficulty. [Min: 0, Max: 1]
_comment_stunArmorBase: Base value added to stun armor at difficulty 0. [Min: 0]
_comment_stunArmorMultiply: How much the added stun armor increases per difficulty. For example, a value of 0.05 means the added stun armor increases by 5% per difficulty. [Min: 0, Max: 1]
_comment_armorNegationBase: Base value added to armor negation at difficulty 0. [Min: 0]
_comment_armorNegationMultiply: How much the added armor negation increases per difficulty. For example, a value of 0.05 means the added armor negation increases by 5% per difficulty. [Min: 0, Max: 1]
_comment_maxStrikesBase: Base value added to max strikes at difficulty 0. [Min: 0]
_comment_maxStrikesMultiply: How much the added max strikes increases per difficulty. For example, a value of 0.03 means the added max strikes increases by 3% per difficulty. [Min: 0, Max: 1]
